phrases.text: Why do pilots yell mayday when they're in trouble?
Blame the French.
London's Croydon Airport had a problem.
Pilots called for help with SOS,
but over a crackly radio,
a single letter gets lost in the static,
and a mistake could be deadly.
So,
the story goes,
a radio officer named Frederick Mockford was asked to find a better word,
one that anyone could hear and anyone could say.
Most of his flights went to Paris,
and in French,
help me is m'aidez.
Say it fast and it sounds like mayday.
it was the official distress call for the whole world.
Pilots say it three times so nobody can miss it.
That's why pilots yell mayday.
It's French for help me,
spelled the English way.
